title: The generalized Fermat equation x² + y⁵ = z⁷
summary: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the main results of the paper "The generalized Fermat equation x² + y⁵ = z⁷" by Manvir Jaswal. Following Putz, a solution is a triple of integers (X, Y, Z) with X⁵ + Y² = Z⁷, gcd(X, Y, Z) = 1 and XYZ ≠ 0; put η = X⁵/Z⁷ and A_η = ℚ[t]/(f_η), where f_η(t) = 4t⁵ψ(t) − η(4t − 1) and ψ(t) = 25t³ + 20t² + 14t + 14. Theorem 1.1 says that A_η is never isomorphic to Putz's octic field L₈ = ℚ[x]/(h), where h(x) = x⁸ + 4x⁷ − 28x⁶ − 168x⁵ − 140x⁴ + 560x³ + 840x² − 480x − 940.
